name: BAS dbsim marker in database audit event
description: Lab detection rule for the Audspect dbsim simulation. Fires when Filebeat extracted dbsim.marker, i.e. a PostgreSQL/MySQL audit or general-log record whose statement BEGINS with the /* dbsim:bas-dbsim:<id> */ marker comment, and the record is not the agent's own meta/audit-lookup statement. Matching is on keyword fields, not text analysis. A lab alert is a HINT, not proof of origin (any DB user can start a statement with the marker); the orchestrator's exact-match post-filter over the alert's original message is the authority. The alert keeps message, event.original, host.name and host.ip.
query: dbsim.marker : * and not dbsim.is_meta : true and not dbsim.is_audit_lookup : true
author: Audspect
